scope: SFC + Master Post live-pilot phasing on JM Die

sfc_pilot_phases.name: bench-sim
sfc_pilot_phases.acceptance: 100% of SFC recommendations pass Vericut force-budget (Fc<spindle_torque*0.7) and chip-load envelope (hex<1.2*recommended). >=95% match published catalog speeds within +/-15%.
sfc_pilot_phases.rollback: Block SFC ship; route to /forge-perf for kc1.1 recalibration. Add failed material to PENDING_GAP_ENGINES.json.

sfc_pilot_phases.name: cut-air
sfc_pilot_phases.acceptance: Motion matches sim within 0.001in. No alarms. Spindle load idle (<5%). Operator confirms feel/sound nominal.
sfc_pilot_phases.rollback: Halt machine. Diff actual NC vs PRISM emit. If post issue -> Master Post bug; if SFC issue -> kinematic correction.

sfc_pilot_phases.name: soft-stock
sfc_pilot_phases.acceptance: Measured cutting force (spindle-load proxy) within +/-20% of SFC prediction. Surface finish Ra within 1.5x target. Zero tool breakage across 10 parts/material.
sfc_pilot_phases.rollback: Lock material in 'shadow-only' mode. Trigger /lathe-learn or /mill-learn calibration on captured force data. Block phase-4 graduation for that material.

sfc_pilot_phases.name: production-shadow
sfc_pilot_phases.acceptance: PRISM recommendation logged alongside operator choice for >=100 ops. Delta < 25% on RPM, <30% on feed. Operator does NOT use PRISM value (shadow). Captured deltas feed calibration.
failure_modes: Recommendations consistently too aggressive vs shop reality
Telemetry gaps (no MTConnect on legacy machine)
sfc_pilot_phases.rollback: Tighten model with shop-floor delta. Engage /shop-knowledge to ingest operator override reasons (tribal tips). No machine impact - shadow is read-only.

sfc_pilot_phases.name: A-B
sample_parts: randomized 50/50 split across 4 high-volume ITW/Optimas SKUs
sfc_pilot_phases.acceptance: PRISM-batch shows: (a) tool life >=95% of status-quo, (b) cycle time <=105% of status-quo (parity OR better), (c) Cpk on critical dim >=status-quo, (d) zero PRISM-induced scrap.
failure_modes: Tool life regression on one tool family (e.g. ceramic inserts)
Cycle-time loss from over-conservative finish pass
Cpk drop from chatter at recommended RPM
sfc_pilot_phases.rollback: Revert that tool/material combo to status-quo. Quarantine recommendation in 'A-B-failed' bucket. Re-train on the regression cohort. No machine harm - operator can override mid-run.

sfc_pilot_phases.name: primary
sfc_pilot_phases.acceptance: PRISM is default for >=80% of new jobs on flagship machines. Operator override rate <15%. Tool life +>=5% vs phase-5 baseline. Zero spindle/collision events attributable to SFC.
failure_modes: Edge-case material PRISM hasn't seen (e.g. Inconel 718 on Mazak-Integrex)
sfc_pilot_phases.rollback: Per-material gate: if novel material encountered, drop to phase-4 shadow for that material until calibrated. Flagship has fallback to operator status-quo via single button.

sfc_pilot_phases.name: telemetry-loop
sfc_pilot_phases.acceptance: Continuous: MTConnect/Mazatrol feed -> /forge-learn -> kc1.1 + Taylor exponent recalibration weekly. Drift detector flags >10% prediction error. Auto-PR for constants update.
sfc_pilot_phases.rollback: Versioned model rollback (model_v_N-1). Manual freeze button. Audit log of every recalibration event.

masterpost_pilot_phases.name: bench-sim
jm_die_machines: none - emit + diff vs known-good post output
sample_parts: 10-program regression suite covering G54-G59, tool-change macros, sub-programs, cycle calls
masterpost_pilot_phases.acceptance: 100% byte-for-byte match against archived JM Die golden NC files for the 4 controllers (with documented allowed deltas e.g. comment lines).
masterpost_pilot_phases.rollback: Per-controller block. Fix in MasterPostEngine + add regression test.

masterpost_pilot_phases.name: cut-air
masterpost_pilot_phases.acceptance: Controller accepts post output with zero alarms. Modal display matches expected at every line. Tool-change sequence correct.
failure_modes: Controller-specific syntax rejected (e.g. Haas G187 vs Fanuc)
masterpost_pilot_phases.rollback: Halt. Diff against archived JM Die program for same controller. Patch post + re-bench-sim.

masterpost_pilot_phases.name: soft-stock
masterpost_pilot_phases.acceptance: Cut motion identical to operator-written equivalent. No dwells/pauses unexpected. Spindle ramps correctly.

masterpost_pilot_phases.name: production-shadow
sample_parts: 10 production jobs run with operator's hand-written/CAM post; PRISM emits parallel post for diff
masterpost_pilot_phases.acceptance: Diff between PRISM-post and operator-post is semantically equivalent (motion identical, only stylistic differences in comments/blocks).
failure_modes: PRISM produces verbose output (operator dislikes style)
masterpost_pilot_phases.rollback: Per-controller style-template adjustment. No machine impact.

masterpost_pilot_phases.name: A-B
sample_parts: A-B split: 50% of jobs use PRISM-post, 50% use existing CAM post
masterpost_pilot_phases.acceptance: Cycle-time delta < 2%. Zero alarms attributable to PRISM-post. Operator-readability rating >=4/5.

masterpost_pilot_phases.name: primary
masterpost_pilot_phases.acceptance: PRISM-post default for new jobs on flagship. Zero collision events. Multi-axis kinematic transforms verified against Mazak SmoothAi simulator.

masterpost_pilot_phases.name: telemetry-loop
masterpost_pilot_phases.acceptance: Post-edit telemetry (operator-touched lines per program) trends toward zero. Style template auto-tunes per controller.

operator_training_artifacts: Phase-3 wax-cut training video (10 min, machine-by-machine)
Phase-4 dual-log dashboard tutorial (operator-facing UI, /shop-floor-query integration)
Phase-5 A-B job-card insert (visual: which jobs are PRISM vs status-quo)
Phase-6 escalation tree (operator -> shop-lead -> programmer -> PRISM-engineer, <5min each tier)
Master-Post per-controller code-style reference cards (Haas, Fanuc, Mazatrol, Okuma, Siemens, Anilam)
Red-button single-press fallback to status-quo (physical button on phase-6 flagship machines)

risk_register.risk: Spindle overload on phase-3 wax cut due to wrong Kienzle for novel alloy
risk_register.mitigation: ForceBudgetGate hard-blocks >70% spindle torque; phase-1 force-budget gate must pass first

risk_register.risk: Collision on flagship Mazak-Integrex phase-6 from multi-axis kinematic miscompile
risk_register.mitigation: All flagship programs must pass Mazak SmoothAi simulator pre-cut; collision-check hook mandatory; single-button operator fallback

risk_register.risk: Tool life regression discovered only in phase-5 A-B (silent until weeks in)
risk_register.mitigation: Per-tool sentinel on tool-life delta; auto-quarantine that tool/material combo within 10 parts

risk_register.risk: Operator rejection of PRISM as 'CAM-textbook' kills adoption before A-B
risk_register.mitigation: Phase-4 shadow MUST capture override reasons (tagged); tribal-tip ingestion before phase-5; operator co-design of phase-5 acceptance criteria

risk_register.risk: Legacy Bridgeport/Anilam DNC pass-through breaks long programs (no MTConnect)
risk_register.mitigation: Limit legacy machines to phase-2/3 short programs; instrument via DNC log capture + manual operator log

risk_register.risk: Wage-of-shop-time burned on phase-2/3 if defects > 1 per phase
risk_register.mitigation: Phase-1 bench-sim must hit 100% acceptance before phase-2 starts; cut-air budget capped at 4 hrs/machine; soft-stock budget capped at 16 hrs/material

risk_register.risk: Post-processor decimal/modal regression breaks legacy archived programs
risk_register.mitigation: Master-Post phase-1 requires byte-equivalence against golden file set across all 4 controllers; CI gate

risk_register.risk: Holo-Krome high-tolerance jobs in phase-6 fail Cpk
risk_register.mitigation: Holo-Krome family enters phase-6 only after dedicated phase-5 A-B exclusively on those jobs; Cpk monitored real-time

risk_register.risk: Telemetry-loop poisoning by sensor failure / outlier
risk_register.mitigation: DriftDetector outlier-rejection + model-version rollback; weekly human-in-loop review of recalibration PRs

risk_register.risk: Calendar slip from shop-conservatism extends each phase
risk_register.mitigation: Pre-negotiate phase budgets with shop lead; carry 25% schedule buffer; declare 'soft graduation' if acceptance is 90%+ and shop confidence holds

summary.verdict: Feasible with disciplined gating; SFC takes 23 weeks to telemetry-loop, Master Post 19 weeks. SFC is the slower path because force-prediction calibration depends on real cutting data which only arrives in phase-3+. Master Post is faster because byte-equivalence testing in phase-1 covers most of the surface.
summary.one_line: SFC=23wks, Master-Post=19wks to phase-7; top risk = flagship multi-axis kinematic miscompile (collision class); start with Haas-TM-1P-2008 for both products.
